raw_text: All changes to network connections and to configurations of network security controls are approved and managed.

raw_text: Inbound traffic to the CDE is restricted to only traffic that is necessary for the CDE.

raw_text: System components are configured and managed securely, consistent with industry-accepted system hardening standards.

explicit_info.requirement: Requirement 2: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components

raw_text: Vendor default accounts, passwords, and SNMP community strings are changed before installing a system on the network.

explicit_info.requirement: Requirement 2: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components

raw_text: Only necessary services, protocols, daemons, and functions are enabled and all unnecessary functionality is removed or disabled.

explicit_info.requirement: Requirement 2: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components

raw_text: Account data storage is kept to a minimum through retention and disposal policies, procedures, and processes.
SAD (Sensitive Authentication Data) is not retained after authorization, even if encrypted.
The PAN (Primary Account Number) is masked when displayed (the maximum number of digits to be displayed are the first six and last four).
PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored using strong cryptography with associated key-management processes.
Strong cryptography and security protocols are implemented to safeguard PAN during transmission over open, public networks.

explicit_info.requirement: Requirement 4: Protect Cryptography of Account Data in Transit

raw_text: PAN is secured with strong cryptography whenever it is sent via end-user messaging technologies (for example, email, instant messaging, SMS, chat).

explicit_info.requirement: Requirement 4: Protect Cryptography of Account Data in Transit
